anchor.method: BA RGBNT100 changes only the initialization directions of existing final fused_classifier.weight versus AV. Whiten original frozen DeMo teacher42 full-official TRAIN class means by TRAIN population variance plus existing fused BN epsilon and gamma; normalize and retain each fresh random row norm. Other heads, final BN parameters/stats, all experts, conditions, route, FFT, optimizer, losses, sampling, params/RNG and final5120 inference graph unchanged. Uses existing immutable AB8675x5120 TRAIN bank from the same originalteacher; no query/gallery features or labels or new encoder passes for initialization. CPU preprocessing/init cost changes, no extra module forward/loss or optimizer updates. Final classifier remains trainable. This is known prototype initialization, not a new frequency mechanism, proof that random heads caused negative gains, or promised +1. anchor.frequency_value_decay_limit: Only two middle/high input Linear weights; low band and every other AS policy retained. Not a new identity mechanism or established cause.
